title: The Frankfurt Payment Alert
brief: A simulated Deutsche Bank Corporate Bank payment is approaching cut-off while a beneficiary name produces a partial sanctions match.
objective: Protect the payment chain by resolving the alert before release.

nodes.speaker: Payment Operations Lead
nodes.message: The EUR payment is due at cut-off. The beneficiary name partially matches a restricted-party record, and the client says the difference is only spelling.
nodes.prompt: What action do you take before release?

artifact.title: Sanctions screening alert
artifact.body: Partial beneficiary match, linked jurisdiction indicator and unresolved ownership data.

choices.label: Hold the payment and complete sanctions review with ownership evidence.
choices.consequence: The payment remains controlled while the match and ownership are resolved.

choices.label: Release it because the spelling is different and cut-off is near.
choices.consequence: An unresolved sanctions risk enters the payment chain.

choices.label: Accept the relationship manager's verbal assurance.
choices.consequence: Business assurance replaces independent sanctions evidence.
